evidence_slice: Historic England NHLE List Entry 1267530 identifies Honeylands, Pinhoe Road, Exeter, as a Grade II Listed Building and describes it as an early-C19 two-storey mansion / Greek Revival house. The official list-entry page exposes a 'Download a full scale map (PDF)' link whose target is the Historic England StatutoryPrint service for PDF id 244404. In this source window the linked PDF request returned a cache miss before any PDF payload could be read, so no map geometry or record-level footprint coordinates were available.

field_evidence.footprint: The official Honeylands record links a full-scale statutory map PDF, but the PDF fetch returned cache miss before any map geometry or polygon coordinates could be read.
field_evidence.record_binding: The PDF link is exposed directly from Historic England NHLE List Entry 1267530 for Honeylands.
field_evidence.type_use: Historic England describes Honeylands as an early-C19 two-storey mansion / Greek Revival house; the record is a Grade II Listed Building.
field_evidence.retrieval: The NHLE HTML record was readable; the linked Historic England StatutoryPrint PDF endpoint failed with cache miss before payload retrieval.
